children.text: The following is a transcription of Genevieve Letarte’s performance at Ultimatum, Wednesday, May 1st, 1985 at the Foufounes Électriques bar and performance space in Montréal, Quebec, Canada. Letarte is an interdisciplinary artist from Montréal, writing under various modes and capacities: she is the author of four novels, among them,
Souvent la nuit tu te reveilles
(1996), a poet, singer and songwriter. Her most recent publication is a poetry collection entitled

(2020). Her performances often combine text, song and music, as does the following multimodal performance from Ultimatum ’85, which mixes sound, song and poetry. The Ultimatum LP features "Petite Nuage et Betelgeueuse" from this set, with electronic percussion by Bernard Poirier, music by Trafic D’Influences, synthesizer and trombone by Claude Saint-Jean, and word and voice by Genevieve Letarte.
